This guide contains requirements that are more qualitative in nature compared to the marketplace guide. Use this page as an app review pre-submission checklist. results.title: How to publish an app to the Stripe App Marketplace | Stripe Documentation
results.snippet: This guide describes how to the Stripe App Marketplace, and how to complete the app review process to verify that your app meets Stripe app standards. If you’re only looking to install your app in a small number of accounts, see external testing. You must activate your account. You can only publish one app per account. Stripe can only support English language listings.

results.title: Build a marketplace | Stripe Documentation
results.snippet: Marketplaces typically charge a commission or fee to their connected accounts for listing their services on their platform. As a marketplace, you’re responsible for paying Stripe fees, which include payment fees (such as transaction and dispute fees) and Connect fees (such as per-account fees and payout fees). In this model, you can earn revenue by: Keeping part of the transaction amount: Charge application fees when transferring funds to connected accounts, or pay out only a portion of the transaction amount.

results.title: Marketplace App Development Cost Explained
results.snippet: Foundation features ($30,000 to $50,000 combined): User registration for both sides, basic listing creation, keyword and category search, standard Stripe or PayPal integration, and an admin panel.
